subject.title: Feature: Processing indicator message for Telegram (send ⌛️ while thinking, delete on reply)

question: Should OpenClaw support a standalone Telegram processing-placeholder message, or should this UX be covered by reactions/typing/presence or a broader cross-channel ack-text feature?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but implementing it adds visible Telegram behavior and new configuration that overlaps with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/80690 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/8285.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow Telegram placeholder
options.body: Add an opt-in Telegram plugin config that sends, tracks, deletes, and edits a standalone placeholder message with focused config, dispatch, docs, and live Telegram proof.

options.title: Fold into broader ack text
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/8285 as the product direction for pre-processing text acknowledgments across channels and keep this as Telegram-specific context.

options.title: Rely on reactions and typing
options.body: Close or de-scope standalone placeholder messages if maintainers prefer less chat noise and want Telegram responsiveness handled by status reactions, typing, or the open presence PR.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow Telegram placeholder
recommendation.body: Add an opt-in Telegram plugin config that sends, tracks, deletes, and edits a standalone placeholder message with focused config, dispatch, docs, and live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He already reviewed this issue and has the strongest sampled Telegram/config history for the affected files.
